responsibility: This file supplies the language hooks that make GNU GIMPLE/LTO behave like a GCC front end. It defines the LTO attribute tables and handlers, initializes builtin and tree-language state needed to read streamed IL, registers LTO-specific dump files, and installs the lang_hooks entries that connect option handling, type construction, section emission, parsing via lto_main, and EH personality selection to the generic compiler driver and middle end.
